**Why:** The user-role-scope workspace loaded users with a single REST call to `/user` (`v=default`, no `limit` or `q`). The REST module returns one page by default, which the question puts at 50 users. Users beyond that first page never reached the picker. The old client-side filter only searched the users already loaded, so an admin could not find them to assign location-scoped stock permissions.

**Fix:** Commit `3c071999` (PR #567, ticket O3-4518) replaced that list with a server-side search. The workspace now uses `useSearchUser`, which queries `/user` with a search string (`q`) and a limit of 10, and the input is debounced by one second. The commit's subject reads "(chore) Update OpenMRS dependencies", which doesn't describe the change, but its diff adds the search and the `O3-4518` comment.

**Evidence, best first:**
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-user-role-scopes/add-stock-user-scope/add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx:93-101` — server-side search replaces the single unfiltered user fetch, with the O3-4518 comment.
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-user-role-scopes/add-stock-user-scope/add-stock-user-role-scope.workspace.tsx:274-290` — the ComboBox now feeds `onInputChange` into the debounced server search.
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-operations/stock-operations-forms/hooks/useSearchUser.ts:9-36` — the hook that sends the search string and a limit of 10 to `/user`.
- `openmrs-esm-stock-management-app/src/stock-lookups/stock-lookups.resource.ts:151-164` — `useUsers`, the unfiltered `/user` fetch that the old code relied on.
- Commit `3c071999ea6f2b75706d5ba602caeba07ec55a02` — the change itself. Its parent (`d5c19f3`) still has `useUsers({ v: Default })` and the client-side `filterItems`, which only searched loaded results.

I did not check the REST module's default page size in its source, so the figure of 50 comes from the question.
